Package org.opencv.core

Class ReduceParams

java.lang.Object
org.opencv.core.ReduceParams
public class ReduceParams extends Object
The reduction that the n-dimensional #reduce performs. Everything the call needs besides the input and the output arrays, in one struct, so that further options can be added without changing the signature. SEE: reduce
